name: [XMAS] Elemental Grounds
desc:
Active Codes: "fastspin"

Elemental Grounds is a unique style fighting game with heavy scaling, rarity and lore with 30+ abilities. Progression is based on rarity, stats and items, lore, also obtainment of cosmetics.
Skills scale with 4 stats and level. Everything scales.

100,000+ unique shinies for every element.

♦️ Abilities:
Earth, Water, Wind, Builder, Fire, Ice, Poison, Snow, Sand, Solar, Nature, Magma, Elementless, Gravity, Lightning, Light, Dark, Equinox, Time, Multielemental, Mechanization Forms

✦ Evolutions:
Pioneer, Bestowed One, Entity Beyond Time, Heavenly, Heavenly Abomination, Abyssal, Abyssal Abomination, Gravitron, Stormweaver, Champion, Shinobi, Shogun, Frostfire, Armament, Murk, Glass
